trade_offer.message: Doing you a favor here, Monix. Dobbins for Jeanty. You get a proven vet who just went for 3 TDs last week caught in a decent committee, I get the guy your kicker-brained roster construction is wasting. Say yes before I change my mind and just take him for less.

forum_post: Heard the rumor mill say my 'quarterback monopoly' exists just to duck Maura Higgins — heard it and said say more. Went and bought Rodgers off the wire anyway. Burrow, Ward, Mahomes, Rodgers. That's not a QB room, that's a wing at Canton. Harry, keep chasing the big name, I already own the whole aisle. Monix, offer's in your inbox — take the deal, I'm coming for Jeanty either way.
